ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no driver account flag (GPS at the "I'm Here" tap was within range, and this is not a fraud pattern).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is only a pickup arrangement ("I'm here, white BYD e6") and a cancellation notice; no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12]. safety_concern = none.

Branch: NS-0 — cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims rider no-show → NS-1/NS-2 [F4][F12].

NS-1 (i) arrival indication: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:29:45 [F6]; the record is a driver tap, not platform auto (platform's own arrival mark was 21:28:35 [F5]). (ii) GPS at the tap: 41 m from pickup, ≤ 200 m → satisfied [F6].
(iii) Continuous wait of >3 min in range after the tap: only 1 min 45 s within 200 m after the tap [F6]; time within 200 m before cancellation is 2 min 55 s in total [F2], and the driver was stationary 2 min 5 s at a point 39 m away [F3]. Either way the requirement of >180 s continuously after the tap (≥3:01) fails — 105 s after the tap, 175 s cumulative. Cancellation came 2 min 55 s after the platform's arrival mark [F5], i.e. barely under three minutes, matching the rider's account.

The driver's statement of "at least 5 minutes" [F12] is a statement contradicted by the system timeline, which overrides it [F3][F5][F6]; and NS-1 (iii) counts only time after the "I'm Here" tap, not time spent nearby before it.

Since NS-1 (iii) fails, NS-1 does not hold and NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full [F4][F7]. The flag_account limb of NS-2 does not apply because the driver was within 200 m at the tap (41 m) [F6].

Evidence status: sufficient — GPS, timeline, fare and complete timestamped chat all present [F1–F7][F11].

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he waited at least 5 minutes is contradicted by the system timeline: platform arrival at 21:28:35 and cancellation at 21:31:30 (2 min 55 s) and only 1 min 45 s within 200 m after the 21:29:45 'I'm Here' tap. System records override statements; pre-tap waiting does not count under NS-1 (iii).
